jobs.description:
Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

jobs.occupation: Technician in day shift - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the area of Oostkamp or Bruges
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not obligated, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC... The company can teach you these on the job.

Are you a driven team player with a passion for agriculture and technology? As operator potato inbound you are at the base of our production, with challenging tasks in quality, technique and logistics. Will you become our new colleague?What will you be doing at Agristo? 
• You will be responsible for the entry control of the quality of the delivered potatoes and for the corresponding administration & registration. 
• You supervise the proper operation of the installation and signal deviations if necessary. 
• You are responsible for cleaning the line and checking various parameters. You can solve first-line disturbances in a professional way, for more complex technical issues you can count on our production technicians. 
• Then you take care of a perfect treatment, namely washing, sorting and stocking of the potatoes. 
• You are also responsible for loading all by-products.
 
• You are socially fluent and keen on quality, safety, order & cleanliness, discipline and punctuality. 
• You are willing to work 2 shifts. 
• You are fluent in a number of current software programs. 
• You are able to drive a forklift truck and terminal truck or are willing to learn to do so. 
• The variety and physical aspect of the job appeals to you. 
• You speak and write Dutch or English fluently.

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Rotating Shifts – Become an essential link at SKF!
jobs.description:
Ready to put your career in motion?

SKF is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly. We are looking for motivated warehouse employees who deliver top-quality service to our customers.

Your role as an order picker:You are a crucial link in our logistics process. Thanks to your speed, precision and eye for detail, you ensure that orders are processed correctly and on time. Do you enjoy working in a dynamic environment and aren’t afraid of a challenge? Then this is the job for you!

Work schedule:

Rotating Shifts: One week 06h until 14h. The next 14h until 22h.

Full-time or part-time. 

For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? No fear of heights?? At least a high school diploma?? You pass our tests on speed, accuracy, numeracy, language skills, spatial insight and attention to detail?? You are physically fit and enjoy active work?? Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Night Shift | Earn €20.85 per hour! – Become an essential link at SKF
jobs.description:
Are you ready to work night shifts and do you already have some experience as an order picker? Then this is your chance!

SKF, specialized in bearings, seals and lubrication systems, is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly daily. We are looking for motivated warehouse workers who provide top-quality service to our customers.

What will you do?? Collect and prepare orders like a true professional? Work with a high order-picking truck (no fear of heights!)? Grow step by step thanks to internal training

Your work schedule:Fixed night shift: Monday evening 22:00 – Saturday morning 06:00 Full-time or part-time. For part-time: Minimum 3 days per week. Option: 5 half days.

?? A high school diploma and initial experience as an orderpicker?? No fear of heights and good physical condition?? Strong comprehension and speaking level of either Dutch or English?? Strong numerical skills, attention to detail and spatial awareness

Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?Would you like to join an international working environment?Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks

• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods

• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe

After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics

• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)

• Can work in a 2-shift system

• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments

So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

We're looking for a Logistics Coordinator. 

In this role you will be responsible for handling laboratory supplies, study materials, medical devices and drug products, used in clinical trials.

Tasks:

• Manage returned materials and maintain inventory records from clinical sites
• Coordinate logistics activities for clinical studies
• Support purchasing activities when required
• Ensure compliance with company procedures and regulatory requirements
• Support the daily operations of the Central Laboratory supply team

A strong knowledge (written and spoken) in English is required, knowledge in another language is a big asset. Logistics tasks such as shipping, calling, mailing, checking in on stock, are interesting to you. A detail and client oriented mentality is needed. You ensure a day to day fluency in logistics and supply chain.

Robert Half is currently looking for a PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) for a company located in the Beringen region.

Our client is an international organization with a well-established European hub in Belgium. The company operates in a fast-moving and structured environment, supporting large-scale operations across multiple countries while maintaining a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The responsibilities for this job as PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) include:

• You take on a pan-European finance controlling role within an international finance team.
• You support financial reporting and controlling activities in close collaboration with local and international stakeholders.
• You report directly to the Finance Manager and contribute to the follow-up of key finance processes.
• You help ensure accurate analysis, reporting, and financial follow-up in an English-speaking business environment.
• You contribute to month-end closing activities and are prepared to provide extra support during the first working days of the month.
• You work closely with a small finance team in a multicultural and structured setting.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field, or you bring equivalent relevant experience.
• You have 1 to 5 years of experience in Accounting, Finance, Audit, or Controlling.
• You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.
• You combine strong analytical skills with the ability to work independently.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office in your daily work.
• You are a professional and respectful communicator with a strong work ethic.
• You have a mature, proactive, and hands-on mindset.
• You feel comfortable in a structured environment.
• You bring experience with SAP, IFRS, VAT, corporate tax, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, or external audits as an advantage.
• You are motivated by working in an international and multicultural environment.

To strengthen our Global IT team, Manuchar is looking for a technically curious and solution-oriented 
Service Desk Engineer. Based at our headquarters in 
Antwerp (Merksem), you will support colleagues worldwide and help ensure they can work efficiently with the right IT tools and systems.
 

You will join an international IT environment where no two days are the same. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, takes initiative and is eager to further develop their IT expertise.
 

Key Responsibilities
 
 

• Provide first-line IT support to colleagues worldwide and support other IT service agents across our global network. 

• Troubleshoot issues involving Microsoft 365, Windows, hardware, networks, servers and internally developed applications. 

• Manage end-user devices, including installation, configuration, maintenance and replacement. 

• Support IT onboarding by setting up accounts, access rights and equipment. 

• Manage incidents and service requests through our ticketing system. 

• Maintain technical documentation, user instructions and IT asset records.  

Your Profile
 
 

• You hold a Bachelor's degree or graduate diploma in IT, or equivalent qualifications through experience, combined with relevant hands-on IT support experience. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
Microsoft 365 and Windows environments. Knowledge of Microsoft Intune, Active Directory, Windows Autopilot, networking or server infrastructure is a plus. 

• You have strong troubleshooting skills and enjoy investigating technical issues independently. 

• You are communicative, approachable, service-minded and comfortable supporting colleagues remotely and in person. 

• You are hands-on, take initiative and are eager to further develop your technical expertise. 

• You enjoy working in an international environment and adapt easily to changing priorities. 

• You are fluent in 
English. Knowledge of Dutch or Spanish is an advantage.  

What We Offer
 
 

• A varied role in a global IT environment with exposure to different technologies and technical challenges. 

• Opportunities to grow towards second-line support, IT Engineering or other IT specialisations. 

• An attractive compensation package including hospitalization and group insurance, meal vouchers, mobile phone with subscription, collective bonus, and more. 

• A supportive team and work environment focused on communication, well-being and professional development.  

Can't wait to join our team?
 

Send your CV and cover letter through our online recruitment tool, Talent Recruiter.
 

Questions? Contact Lise Polfliet, HR Assistant, at recruitment@manuchar.com.
 

Manuchar, a multinational of Belgian origin
 

Manuchar is a leading distributor of chemicals across high-growth markets and also trades commodities such as steel and polymers. With more than 40 years of local presence and over 180 locations worldwide, we provide end-to-end commercial, supply chain and financing solutions.
 

Our mission:“Connecting the World. For Better Lives."

Our client is a leading Belgian construction and engineering group active in construction, real estate development and concessions.

With an international presence and approximately 10,000 employees across more than 25 countries, the company delivers complex construction and infrastructure projects in Belgium and abroad.

 

As a Project Buyer, you are responsible for managing procurement activities within an assigned scope of construction projects. Working closely with the project teams, you ensure that works, supplies and services are purchased under the best possible conditions, while taking into account technical requirements, project planning, costs, risks and QHSES standards.

You report to the Head Buyer and work in close collaboration with the various project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage procurement activities independently within your assigned scope.
• Handle the full procurement process, from defining the sourcing strategy and preparing requests for quotation to negotiating and finalizing contracts.
• Advise project teams on procurement matters and provide input on market conditions and sourcing opportunities.
• Work closely with multidisciplinary teams, including engineering, design, construction planning, finance, legal and procurement specialists.
• Identify and engage with potential subcontractors, suppliers and service providers.
• Prepare requests for quotation based on technical and operational requirements provided by the project teams.
• Analyze and compare offers from both a technical and financial perspective.
• Organize clarification meetings and lead commercial negotiations.
• Support project teams in the supplier selection and award decision process.
• Ensure proper contract documentation and administrative follow-up.

Your Profile

We are open to candidates with either a technical background in civil engineering or previous experience in procurement:

Civil Engineering / Construction background

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering or a related technical discipline.
• You have a solid understanding of civil works and are interested in developing your career towards procurement and purchasing.
• Exposure to construction projects, technical coordination, subcontractors, tendering or cost estimation would be an asset.
Procurement / Buyer background

• Alternatively, you have previous experience in procurement or purchasing within the construction or civil engineering sector.
• You are familiar with sourcing, subcontracting, supplier management and contract negotiations.
• You have a good understanding of procurement processes and contract administration.
Regardless of your background, you bring:

• A strong interest in construction procurement and the commercial aspects of projects.
• A good understanding of civil works, particularly concrete, reinforcement, formwork and post-tensioning, or the ability to develop this knowledge.
• Excellent level of Dutch, both written and spoken (mandatory), and a good command of English.
• Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills.
• The ability to work collaboratively with technical and operational stakeholders.
